Get land prices

Source: R/land-price-get.R
land_price_get.Rd

Returns the sites of the official land prices (地価公示) of National Land Numerical Information in a year, one row per site, as published. The first call for a year downloads the file of that year's release (via ksjdata) and builds the table, which is then cached.

Usage

land_price_get(year)

Source

Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, National Land Numerical Information, 地価公示データ (L01): https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-L01-2026.html. The terms of use are on https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/other/agreement_01.html.

Arguments

year

Reference year, from 2007 to the latest release. See land_price_files() for the available years. To get several years, iterate over them, for example with purrr::map(): the coordinate reference system differs between releases, so bind them after making it the same.

Value

An sf tibble with one row per site:

  • year: The reference year (integer). Prices are as of January 1.

  • release: The year of the release the values are taken from (integer). It is year.

  • city_code: Five-digit municipality code of the number of the site (標準地番号), as published for that year. Designated cities are split into wards.

  • use_code: Three-digit use of the site (用途区分), as published. The codes are those of the code list of the latest release (000 住宅地, 003 宅地見込地, 005 商業地, 009 工業地, 013 林地) and, until 2012, also 007 and 010, which are not used from 2013. The files of 2014 to 2016 have no sites of 003 or 013. Compare uses across these breaks with care.

  • site_number: Three-digit serial number of the site within its municipality and use, as published. city_code, use_code, and site_number identify a site within a year; numbers can change between years.

  • price_jpy_per_m2: The price in yen per square meter.

  • geometry: The point of the site, as published. Its coordinate reference system is that of the release: JGD2000 (EPSG:4612) until 2023 and JGD2011 (EPSG:6668) from 2024. The files until 2017 have no .prj file, and are set to JGD2000, the datum of the catalog.

Details

The year is taken from its own release, so it covers every site that was surveyed in it, and its values do not change when a later release is published. The sites are not summarised: summarise them by municipality, by grid square, or by use as the analysis needs.

The first time in a session, the terms of use are shown. Published or processed data must credit the source (National Land Numerical Information, 地価公示データ, by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism), and processed data must say that they were processed.

See also

land_price_target() to declare the table as a target.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
sites <- land_price_get(2020)

# Median price of residential sites by municipality
sites |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::filter(use_code == "000") |>
  dplyr::summarise(price = median(price_jpy_per_m2), .by = city_code)
}
